scientific_integrity: The analytical coefficient proof covers every positive dimensionless loss triple; standard-library exact-rational tests are supplemental. Earliest fully day-resolved motivating full text is first published on 2002-12-04; earlier 1995 box-transport literature establishes context but only month/year is verified for its first public version.
scientific_limitations: Idealized three equal-volume boxes, shared symmetric exchange, strictly first-order losses, constant throughflow, and a single localized input; no empirical parameter calibration, transient exposure prediction, or general multi-box theorem. Historical priority not independently established.
title: A sharp three-box mixing-rate law for reactive downstream export
